tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should furnish the Registration Certificate of labour licence issued by the Labour Department with requisite validity.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
GST Registration Certificate.
Copy of Income Tax Returns filed. Financial Year 2024-25 Assessment year 2025-26.
EPF Registration Certificate.
ESI Registration Certificate.

The intending bidder/firm/company should have satisfactorily completed at least one similar nature of service Labour oriented Man Power Services as (Patkaries/Sowdy, Canal Sluice Operator, Gangmen, Gauge Reader, Car/Jeep vehicle Driver, Sweeper/Scavenger, Mazdoor Heavy, Valvemen, Watchman, Plumber and Computer operator) of value not less than 50 percent of the amount put to tender of Rs. 109.81 Lakhs during the last five years from 2021-22 to 2025-26. The Work Done Certificate should be obtained duly signed from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division. An additional weightage of 10 percent each year will be added to the cost of the work done in previous years to bring it to the present price level 2026-27.

The bidder should have an annual financial turnover of minimum of amount put to tender Rs.439.22 Lakhs in two financial years during the last five years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26). Certificate issued by the Chartered Accountant should be enclosed & mention UDIN No. (Additional weightage at 10% for each year shall be given for turn over to bring it to 2026-27).

Liquid assets and /or available or credit facilities of not less than amount put to tender Rs. 65.88 Lakhs credit line or credit or certificates from nationalized bank or schedule bank for meeting the funds requirement etc., usually the equivalent estimate flow for 3 months to make advance payment to labour service.

BID capacity:Tenderer who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under. Assessed available tender capacity equals to (AxNx1.50-B) A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited equals to 1 Year.B is Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 year (Period of completion of the works for which tenders are invited).

The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
Financial turnover of previous years indicated in clause 3.2(b)4 above shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of 2026-27.
The evaluation of Technical Bid cover I for qualification will only be done based on the information provided by the contractor as uploaded documents in e-portal duly verified (if necessitates).
Tenderer who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value.

The Contractor should furnish the name of the individual/firm with address & mobile No with Place of registration year of incorporation etc. If it is a Firm, Registration Certificate issued from the Registrar of Firms.

FINANCIAL BID COVER- II SHALL CONTAIN THE FOLLOWING :The Financial Bid Documents for the above service comprises of financial bid to indicate the amount offered by the bidder for supply of Labour service/Man power mentioned in the tender notification

The concerned Agency should submit the EPF & ESI Details of all the engaged manpower Along with Aadhar number during submission of monthly bills compulsorily, Otherwise the bill will not be considered.
The Agency has to pay the variable DA to the labours as per the prevailing Govt Orders the same shall be considered in the RA Bills
Contractor has to quote for Total amount in lumpsum for basic plus DA plus service charges . not to quote lumpsum amount in 1% or 2% etc if so the tender will be rejected.
The lumpsum amount quoted by the bidder shall not be less than the total amount of basic plus DA if it is less the tender will be rejected.
The Agency has to remit the employers part and labour part of ESI & EPF amount by opening account in each individuals name or to the already existing account
The Agency has to engage the manpower for the work between 18 years to 60 years age.
The Agency has to provide required Tools and Equipments to manpower engaged in water management of canals and cleaning essentials engaged in housekeeping ,dam & Colony maintenance at his own cost.
The Agency has to provide different type uniform based on their work to all the manpower engaged at his own cost.

Manpower labours/staff supplied by the man power Agency are the workers of the manpower Agency not workers KNNL/WRD. The services of the manpower are temporary and they are not eligible for the departmental benefits.

The manpower supplying Agency is responsible for the proper water management of canals, maintenance of dams and offices etc. The labours supplied shall do the jungle clearance, removal of silt in the canals entrusted to them along with water management as directed by the department Engineers.
Failure of water management by the labours supplied by manpower agencies will be treated as breach of contract and liable for action.

The lowest bidder (L 1) will be asked to produce the original document before awarding of the service. In case the lowest bidder fails to produce the original documents for entering in to an agreement or the Original documents submitted does not match with the uploaded documents or found false, then his bid is treated as non responsive bid. The name of lowest bidder who does not produce the original documents would be removed from the select list of KNNL enrolment and KPWD registration and barred from the participation in any of the tenders invited by the KNNL there after apart from forfeiting the EMD paid through e-cash.

The tenderer is requested to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance well before the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The Nigam (KNNL)/department shall not be responsible for non accessibility of e-procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.

The necessary certificates/documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to their e-tender documents. The Original certificates/documents shall be produced if necessitates.
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day is valid.
Further information can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer,

Conditional tenders shall be rejected and EMD shall be forfeited The Officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons whatsoever.
Corrigendum will be published in the web site only for all modifications/corrections if any.
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address and e-mail address in the declaration form.
Department has no binding/obligation for providing quarters or any civic amenities for the accommodation of workers provided by the Agency.

The payment of bills is dependent on the availability of funds in the department/Nigam. However non payment of regular monthly bills should not be a reason for stoppage of rendering man power services.
The rates paid to the persons engaged by the Man Power Agency (for various categories of work) should not be less than Minimum Wages as declared from the Labour Department of Government of Karnataka.
Tenders will be opened on the due date in presence of the contractors or their authorized representatives.
The Contractor/Firm shall send the authorization letter of their representatives, duly attested by their signature while participation during opening of bids.
The tender processing charges paid by the bidders are non-refundable, even if the tenders are cancelled and Incomplete tenders will be summarily rejected.
For further any references of this tender would be referred to standard bid document KC-8 conditions will be considered.
The evaluation will only be done based on the information provided by the contractor as uploaded in the e-portal.

The tenderer has to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance well before the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The Nigam (KNNL)/Department shall not be responsible for non accessibility of e-procurement Portal due to internet connectivity issues, any technical glitches or any other issues.
Typo-graphical errors (if any) will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor.
Tendering by Joint Venture are not Allowed.

In case of delay in the payment of employee by the Nigam the payment should be made by the Agency on their own with in 07th of every month. Reasons for delay in the payment of salary of employees should not be thrust / attributed to the Nigam.
The Agency shall regularly remit the EPF, other relevant Taxes and Cess to the government as per Rules.

Agency shall provide proof of having remitted EPF/Taxes/ Cess / ESI to the Government of monthly payment through nationalized bank to the employees in the succeeding months with the bill, failing which this office will withhold further payment to the Agency.
For any disputes/ problems with the Man Power Services supplied in accordance with Labour Law, the department bears no responsibility what so ever. The Agency will solely be responsible for the same

Considering the availability of funds, the bill of the Agency will be paid. But before this, the tenderer should take care to supply adequate water to the notified crops. With proper water management and upon ascertaining the same, the bills of the tenderer shall be paid

The Employer reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantum of Man Power Services with in the contract period and Agency shall have no claim of any nature what so ever. The Agency shall pay the salary and allowances to the Man Power staff category wise not less than the break up provided at the time of agreement, the Agency shall agree to indemnify the department to compensate to department in case of any loss or damage occurred involving department equipments/ assets due to negligence of Man Power staff so deployed.

During the period of contract, tendered shall abide at all times, all existing Labour Enactments, rates of wages and Rules made their under, regulations, notifications and Bye Laws of State government, Central Government and Local Authority.

The Successful tenderer should give the details of name of all outsourcing manpower daily duty chart for various sections in which they are employed and everyday attendance should be taken jointly from the Agency & departmental officials / Engineers. If the worker fails to work as assigned, the Agency has to take action and replace immediately .

In case of any employee abstaining from the work, either on long leave or under any other circumstances shall be removed from the site by the department for his misconduct, The Agency should immediately provide suitable substitute, so that work does not got hampered.
The Employer can terminate the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason what so ever without any prior notice.

Muster Roll of its/ his employee shall be maintained by the Agency/firm and payment will strictly be made based on the number of personnel who have attended work in any given month as per indent of the Engineer In Charge.
The agencies shall supply the manpower labour/staff who possess the prior experience of water management in major and medium irrigation system of the government.
The rate considered in bill of quantities are inclusive of EPF, ESI and GST will be paid wherever it is applicable.

The Agency Shall supply man power experienced in water management/ watch and ward / sanitation, water supply works / Electrician/ Experience drivers with license holder and should be Tungabhadra Command Area.
If two or more bidder quoted same lowest price to the work, the award of work will be done by lottery system and the date for which will be intimated.
Before Participation in the Tender, bidder should visit the worksite to know the nature of work.
The Agency has to make the Retrospective payment of manpower supplied for water management, maintenance of camp and office maintenance as directed by executive engineer.

Within 10 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Executive Engineer, a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract.
Agency has to pay the minimum wages as per the labour department GOs.
The Agreement will be finalized by including EPF & ESI at the time of Evaluation/ Contract Execution.

As per Ministry Of Finance Department of Expenditure procurement policy dtd: 06-01-2023 the minimum Service charges in the Eproc of Man Power Outsourcing service may be fixed as 3.85% amount Which is included in Amount put to tender.

The agency has to make the manpower supplied for maintenance of camp and office (like Mazdoor, Typist/Computer operator, Driver & the workers that are mentioned in similar nature) from Dtd: 01.01.2027.
The agency has to make the payment of manpower supplied for water management from the date of water inflow in the canal from 01.01.2027 (during water period only).
EMD of the unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after the acceptance of tenders by the competent authority.
EMD of successful bidders will be refunded only after the Conclusion of the tenders by the competent authority and Security deposit will be refunded after completion of work.
